verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that SREs can build and share custom dashboards through the UI, including publicly accessible live dashboard URLs. The dashboards offer high-density interactive visualizations, and NRQL powers the built-in charts and dashboards. No evidence covers template variables, and the range of visualization types is only described generically. missing for 10: template variables, a documented catalog of visualization types, dashboards-as-code (API/Terraform dashboard definitions), independent hands-on corroboration.
